## JubileeBrowser 8.0.12

### What's New
- Fixed auto-update check that was failing with incorrect URL construction
- Update endpoint now correctly checks for new versions
- All previous features from 8.0.11 included

See https://jubileebrowser.com/releases for full release notes.

## JubileeBrowser 8.0.11

### What's New
- Theme Support: Dark and Light theme resource dictionaries with ThemeManager service
- System theme detection and real-time monitoring of OS theme changes
- Startup Performance: Optimized browser launch to prevent system resource exhaustion
- Limited tab restoration to maximum 10 tabs on startup
- Background services now initialize in batches

See https://jubileebrowser.com/releases for full release notes.

## JubileeBrowser 8.0.8

### What's New
- Resizable To-Do List panel with drag handle
- Enhanced menu icon visibility in both browsing modes
- Spiritual Nutrition Panel improvements
- Updated authentication with InspireCodex.com API
- Self-contained deployment (no .NET installation required)
- Content filtering with 309,000+ blocked sites
- Dual-mode navigation (Internet/Jubilee Bible)

See https://jubileebrowser.com/releases for full release notes.

## JubileeBrowser 8.0.7

### What's New
- Professional MSI installer for easy deployment
- Improved installation experience with Windows shortcuts
- All files from 8.0.6 plus installer improvements

### Previous Features (8.0.6)
- Platform migration from Electron to .NET 8 WPF
- Self-contained deployment (no .NET installation required)
- WebView2 engine for modern web rendering
- Enterprise-ready MSI installer support
- Auto-update system with SHA256 verification
- Secure credential storage via Windows Credential Manager
- Tab groups and session persistence
- Content filtering with 309,000+ blocked sites

See https://jubileebrowser.com/releases for full release notes.
